| 0 | `OK` | Success. |
| 1 | `UNKNOWN_MESSAGE` | Message type not known to the receiver. |
| 2 | `MALFORMED` | Header or TLV structure invalid, wrong fixed width, bad bool, duplicate non-repeated field, tag 0, or below min_len. |
| 3 | `UNSUPPORTED_VERSION` | Header ver is not the receiver's protocol major. |
| 4 | `MISSING_FIELD` | A required field is absent. |
| 5 | `TOO_LARGE` | Field longer than max_len, message larger than the channel limit, or payload larger than allowed. |
| 6 | `INVALID_UTF8` | A str or id field is not valid UTF-8. |
| 7 | `INVALID_ID` | An id field contains characters outside [a-z0-9._-] or starts with '.'. |
| 8 | `OUT_OF_RANGE` | Integer outside min/max, or config enum value unknown to the board. |
| 9 | `UNKNOWN_KEY` | Config key not known to (or not applicable on) this board; skipped. |
| 10 | `TYPE_MISMATCH` | Config value length does not match the key's type. |
| 11 | `READ_ONLY` | Config key cannot be written. |
| 12 | `REVISION_CONFLICT` | expected_revision differs from the current config revision. |
| 13 | `INSUFFICIENT_SECURITY` | Link not encrypted/bonded (non-BLE transports; BLE enforces this at the ATT layer). |
| 14 | `BUSY` | Another operation is in progress. |
| 15 | `NO_SPACE` | Not enough storage. |
| 16 | `BAD_OFFSET` | Chunk offset is not the next expected offset. |
| 17 | `NO_SESSION` | Unknown or expired transfer handle. |
| 18 | `CRC_MISMATCH` | CRC-32 of the received data does not match. |
| 19 | `HASH_MISMATCH` | SHA-256 of the received data does not match. |
| 20 | `SIGNATURE_INVALID` | Firmware signature missing or not trusted. |
| 21 | `IMAGE_INVALID` | Firmware image or asset content fails format validation. |
| 22 | `LOW_BATTERY` | Battery below the board's OTA threshold and no external power. |
| 23 | `VERSION_REJECTED` | Firmware version is not newer than the running one. |
| 24 | `NOT_FOUND` | Asset, app or notification not found. |
| 25 | `UNSUPPORTED` | Feature, kind or asset type not supported by this board/variant. |
| 26 | `SEGMENT_ERROR` | Segment sequence error during reassembly. |
| 27 | `INTERNAL` | Unexpected internal error. |

| ID | Name | Type | Range / enum | Default | Variants | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x0001 | `ui.language` | u8 | enum `language` | `0` | all | 0.1.0 | On-device UI language. |
| 0x0002 | `display.orientation` | u8 | 0..3 | `0` | all | 0.1.0 | Rotation in 90 degree steps. |
| 0x0003 | `display.full_refresh_every` | u8 | 1..100 | `30` | paper | 0.1.0 | E-paper: full refresh after this many partial refreshes (a clock redraw counts as one, anything else as a quarter; a full refresh that falls due waits for a quiet moment). Default 10 before 0.9.2. |
| 0x0004 | `display.show_body` | bool |  | `true` | all | 0.1.0 | Show message body (false = title only, for privacy). |
| 0x0005 | `ui.clock_24h` | bool |  | `true` | all | 0.6.0 | Clock format: true = 24-hour, false = 12-hour with AM/PM. |

| 0x0007 | `display.brightness` | u8 | 0..100 | `70` | lcd | 0.8.0 | Backlight brightness in percent while active (0 = off). |
| 0x0008 | `display.idle_dim_s` | u16 |  | `30` | lcd | 0.8.0 | Dim the backlight after this many seconds without activity; 0 = never. |
| 0x0009 | `display.idle_off_s` | u16 |  | `60` | lcd | 0.8.0 | Switch the backlight and the panel off after this many seconds without activity; 0 = never. Default 300 before 0.12.1. |
| 0x000A | `display.mask_numbers` | bool |  | `false` | all | 0.10.1 | Privacy: show every number of 4 or more digits as **** on the cards (one-time codes, balances); digits may be joined by . or , (1.234 and 1,234,567 are one number). |

| 0x0013 | `notif.show_silent` | bool |  | `true` | all | 0.1.0 | Show notifications flagged silent. |
| 0x0020 | `quiet.enabled` | bool |  | `false` | all | 0.1.0 | Quiet hours on/off. |

| 0x0022 | `quiet.end_min` | u16 | 0..1439 | `420` | all | 0.1.0 | Quiet hours end, minutes after local midnight (may be before start: spans midnight). |
